facts.fact: 第一节开头：Giada 赤身裸体在屋里又跳又唱，把发梳当话筒，然后瘫倒在床上。
facts.anchor: Giada dances naked, singing and skipping about the room.

facts.fact: Giada 对裸体的执念只有 Angela（Wendy）懂；两人想过天体沙滩又放弃，嫌那是「沙丘后面站满偷窥者的隔离区」。
facts.anchor: Angela is the only one who understands this passion of hers.

facts.fact: 长角幼崽 Peter 站在床边盯着 Giada，眼神是有意图的审视而非动物式走神，并模仿她把手放到腿间。
facts.anchor: Peter mimics Giada’s movement, bringing a little hand between his legs.

facts.fact: Michele 翘课（周一下雨）骑摩托到斗兽场附近，按父亲黑笔记本里的地址找到一家连招牌都没有的小珠宝店。
facts.anchor: Papa’s notebook contained an address from these parts.

facts.fact: 店里是一位白发夹杂、笑容开朗的女士，Michele 鼓起勇气确认她就是 Irene。
facts.anchor: She has long hair streaked with white and an open smile.

facts.fact: Irene 一听「我是 Stefano Cavaterra 的儿子」就担心地起身到门口左右张望，确认只有他一个人。
facts.anchor: A wrinkle of concern furrows the woman’s brow; she rises suddenly and goes to the door.

facts.fact: Irene 否认撒旦教，说他们属于 Nemi 林中 Diana 神庙的女巫团（coven），延续女神与上帝、所谓 witchcraft 的古老传统。
facts.anchor: Your father was a pagan, not a Satanist.

facts.fact: Michele 复述父亲讲的 Rex Nemorensis——杀老林王即成新王，直到被人杀；Irene 答时代变了、她们的团从没杀过人。
facts.anchor: It was a title passed on by murder: whoever killed the King took his place.

facts.fact: 谈「父亲是否真信 Diana」时 Irene 给出全书认识论关键句：Stefano 不是相信，而是知道。
facts.anchor: Your father didn’t believe. Your father knew.

facts.fact: Irene 说最后几页笔记写的是 Augusto Dal Mare：他与 Stefano 情同兄弟却背叛众人，冲突导致女巫团解散、她离开 Nemi。
facts.anchor: But Augusto betrayed us all.

facts.fact: Michele 烧到站不住，Irene 要他先病愈再来听故事，并警告无论如何躲开 Dal Mare。
facts.anchor: Meanwhile, whatever happens, stay away from Augusto Dal Mare.

facts.fact: 对应 ch01 与 ch09 涂鸦：Irene 说古老之物以新形重生、旧故事回到 Flesh，并点出 Faunus／潘后说出「他要回来了」。
facts.anchor: He’s coming back,” says Irene.

facts.fact: 第三节点：Wendy 在店里吃面包萨兰米配啤酒、刷网页等演出邀约，Dal Mare 拄拐杖突然出现，她连起身都不肯。
facts.anchor: Augusto,” Wendy emphasises.

facts.fact: 十四年前在 Nemi 父亲只对 Wendy 说 Augusto 是坏人，此后才有争吵、诊断与病情；只有 Wendy 记得此事。
facts.anchor: He used those words only with her: Michele and Giovanni were too little, Mama wouldn’t have understood.

facts.fact: Dal Mare 自称昨晚与 Giovanni 晚餐，声称要与旧友和解，并提出能借经纪人 Aldo Miglio 替 Wendy 牵线，说要给的是「平衡」而非恩惠。
facts.anchor: I heard that your agent is Aldo Miglio, one of my friends, even if not among the most reputable of them.

facts.fact: 第四节（承上节未完的 And …）：发着高烧的 Michele 湿衣扑到床上、失去意识「离开了」。
facts.anchor: He throws himself on the bed, still in his soaking clothes.

facts.fact: 第五节：Luisa 连值十五小时（大环道车祸＋流感倒下半数同事），刚出医院就被夜里风包住，希望自已不是一个人。
facts.anchor: She has worked fifteen hours in a row, because there’s been a bad accident on the big ring road, and as if that wasn’t enough, an outbreak of flu has laid up half her colleagues.

facts.fact: 两个男人（烂牙带弹簧刀、絮叨的红肚巾大汉 Skull and Bones）在 Ponte Fabricio 附近堵住 Luisa，喊她救命的路人毫无反应。
facts.anchor: “There’s a cage on the ship,” says Rotten Teeth.

facts.fact: Luisa 奔跑时空间像橡皮筋拉长，她跌倒却落在沙滩上——星空、海浪与锚泊的帆船，罗马街道像投影仍在远处。
facts.anchor: The space stretches like elastic, and suddenly the youths are far, far away, at the bottom of a funnel kilometres long.

facts.fact: 烂牙的刀变成锈波浪刀、破布成航海衣；Skull and Bones 一脚踢进她腹部后放话：若神出现，船长也能杀神。
facts.anchor: Go ahead and pray,” he allows. “And if a god shows up, the Captain can kill him.

facts.fact: 第六节：Silvia 给 Michele 敷醋水凉巾，Giovanni 追问父亲最后的研究与和 Augusto 的争吵，她答「什么也不知道」。
facts.anchor: Giovanni’s spent the whole day at home, rummaging around in search of something.

facts.fact: Silvia 视角：丈夫确诊后亲友散尽，只有 Augusto 留下（生日卡、圣诞礼物），她因此感激他，并抱怨 Angela 不觉察。
facts.anchor: Only Augusto had remained.

facts.fact: Silvia 为孩子们守夜帮忙感到欣慰，认为「互相扶持」是她和 Stefano 教出来的；Giovanni 留下接替凉巾，让她睡半小时。
facts.anchor: There’s no more formidable force than a united group.

facts.fact: Giovanni 泡毛巾时发现查了一整天毫无所获：日记、笔记都没有，连 The Secret 里也没有父亲的字。
facts.anchor: They must have been thrown away with thousands of other scraps.

facts.fact: Giovanni 想不通 Augusto 为何在帆船上撒谎，把父亲、神秘赤脚少年、岛、Angela 与 Luisa 的奇迹串成需要「结构」的问题（引 Lévi-Strauss）。
facts.anchor: There must be a structure underneath, and that is the business of anthropology, finding the structure, it was the great Levi Strauss who said as much.

facts.fact: 结尾段前：Giovanni 照看发烧的弟弟，Michele 身体微颤，其余部分「正在别处旅行」。
facts.anchor: The rest of him is travelling elsewhere.

facts.fact: 尾声（船长视角）：Dal Mare＝Captain Hook，打算留 Angela  alive 以「驯服」她；因她从未 Broken Enchantment 且拒绝交易，她在 Dream 与 Flesh 里仍是自由人。
facts.anchor: Angela has never Broken Enchantment and has refused to strike a deal with him: this leaves her a free woman, in Dream as in Flesh.

facts.fact: 船长率十八岁少年与三个 grunt 破门洗劫 Angela 住所（摔镜子、掀魔法箱），进卧室却找不到她，也找不到「他」。
facts.anchor: riddled with dry rot, it collapses

facts.fact: 船长要找另一名与 Angela 同在公园的女孩，要把 Barrie 的牢栏砸开，须在敌人显形前找到他；显节日将近，潘随时归来。
facts.anchor: The time is short, his Epiphany approaches.
